name: aether
description: Aether mode for Claude Code, built for RADAR: rapid, autonomous, delegating, affordable and robust. The Lead starts on Sonnet and is the owner's right hand: it understands the intent, writes the owner's intent card, and launches /aether:design, which runs the design on its own, then orchestrates the build along three paths: itself, delegate tasks on models it chooses, or the swarm. A Writer on Sonnet writes specs, plans and tasks in Spec Kit's layout, and a Judge on Opus reviews them. A parallel swarm of Haiku, Sonnet and Opus implementers builds them, each attempt supervised and every merge made one at a time. Lanes run its calls on other coding plans, such as agy, while their quota lasts, and the seats option lets stronger models of other harnesses take the Judge, the Writer and the Examiner, who writes a hidden acceptance exam. With the owner's permission, the Lead works for hours and ends with a brief.

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: Run Aether's calls on agy while its quota lasts. Off by default: agy runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions and spends another plan's quota. Linux only.

harnesses.title: Lane harnesses
harnesses.description: The external harnesses lanes may use, comma-separated: agy, codex, grok, cursor. The quota decides the order of the candidates; the order of this option breaks ties between equal priorities and orders the groups with no reading. Default: agy. Each one runs its CLI without permission prompts in Aether's transactional worktree, with your git, GitHub, package-registry and cloud credentials kept out of its environment. Turn one on only once you accept that risk.

ops.title: Ops in the mod
ops.description: Run the swarm's own aether-wt and aether-lane commands in the mod, without a model. On by default. Turn it off when your project's test command needs your shell's environment, which the mod's does not have: the Haiku ops agent then runs them with the Bash tool, as before 0.8.

seats.title: Design seats
seats.description: Who takes the Judge, the Writer and the Examiner: native (Aether's own agents, as in 0.8), balanced (Gemini 4 Argon on agy judges and examines; the Writer stays native) or robust (Argon writes the plan, and the Judge stays native on Opus). An external model takes a seat only with lanes on, its harness enabled and its quota left; otherwise the native agent takes it. Only the design seats change: the swarm's models and efforts still follow each task's Tier and Review.

router.title: Delegate router
router.description: Who chooses the model and effort of the Lead's delegate tasks: record (the Lead chooses, and Aether records what the decider would have chosen, in the background), advise (the Lead also gets the decider's choice as a notice) or command (the decider chooses, unless the Lead overrides it with a reason). It applies only to the Lead's delegate tasks, never to the swarm, the design seats or the aether agents. Default: record.

decider.title: Router decider
decider.description: What decides for the router: haiku (Claude Haiku at low effort, with no outside service) or jev (typesafe/jev-1.14 on OpenRouter: it sends each delegate brief to a third party, and needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment or in the .env of the plugin data directory). Default: haiku.

fallback.title: Router fallback rung
fallback.description: The model and effort a delegate task runs on when the router cannot decide and the Lead asked for none, written as alias:effort. The aliases are haiku, sonnet and opus; the efforts are low, medium, high, xhigh and max. Default: sonnet:high.

deadlines.title: Router time limits
deadlines.description: How long the router waits, in seconds, for each decider and for the quota decision, written as haiku=8,jev=3,quota=3; a value above 10 counts as 10. In record mode nothing waits, because the decider runs in the background. Default: haiku=8,jev=3,quota=3.
